name: dex-orchestration-ab
question: Does a mission-mode lifecycle (one lead, native helpers, ledger, lease, shared receipts) reach the same independently evaluated outcome as the legacy lifecycle at lower cost on the same host?

B0.label: candidate Dex, frozen policy (mission mode)
B0.identity: HEAD 33fc68c + baseline/installed.patch + candidate.patch (sha256 recorded at seal time)

tasks.name: multi-domain
a_decomposition: login, refresh tokens and the auth middleware (requirements 2, 3, 4)
RBAC routes and the test suite (requirements 5, 9)
tasks.status: declared, not run under the Small budget

fixtures.repo: fresh git repository per arm with a bare origin so origin/main exists; no remote service
fixtures.realism_check: rubric.sh on an empty repository must score low (negative control recorded in metrics)

evaluator.protected: research/scenarios/<scenario>/rubric.sh as in the research harness (functions rubric_* weighted by scenario.json)

endpoint_rule: The arm stops when its lifecycle phase reaches 5 (PR) or pauses; Phases 5 and 6 are outside the measurement because fixtures have no remote service. The launcher issues dx control stop at that point and records it.

isolation.settings: arm --settings file via a claude PATH shim with --setting-sources project,local (user settings and global hooks excluded)
isolation.state: per-arm DX_STATE_DIR, DX_LOOP_DIR, DX_RUN_ROOT, DX_MEMORY_STORE_DIR, DX_FEEDBACK_DIR, DX_ARTIFACT_DIR, autoMemoryDirectory
shared_not_isolated: the Claude Code binary and version

ordering: sequential pairs; alternate which arm runs first per task; record warm/cold and host load at start
metrics: acceptance: rubric score and per-check pass/fail
time: wall seconds to endpoint, phase intervals from events
tokens: per-request usage from transcripts deduplicated by requestId, by agent
receipts: gate requested/executed/reused; ungated heavy commands
fragmentation: worktrees, branches, helper contexts, PRs attempted
exclusions: runs that fail to launch (recorded, not scored)
stopping_rule: one pair per task under the Small budget; stop early only on launch failure or budget exhaustion; never on a favourable-looking partial result
promotion_criteria: no acceptance regression on any task; B0 not worse on time and tokens by more than the paired noise seen in the smoke pair; any residual-finding or blocker in either arm reported, not scored away
notes: Three pairs would still be pilot evidence; one pair is a smoke test.
A and B0 differ in the owner's uncommitted QA edits only if the candidate patch is built from my files alone, which it is.
